shortDescription: Sends a message to logged in users on Windows hosts

options.name: display_seconds
options.description: How long to wait for receiver to acknowledge message, in seconds.

options.name: msg
options.description: The text of the message to be displayed. The message must be less than 256 characters.

options.name: to
options.description: Who to send the message to. Can be a username, sessionname or sessionid.

options.name: wait
options.description: Whether to wait for users to respond.  Module will only wait for the number of seconds specified in display_seconds or 10 seconds if not specified. However, if I(wait) is C(yes), the message is sent to each logged on user in turn, waiting for the user to either press 'ok' or for the timeout to elapse before moving on to the next user.
